lines: Rahul Bahri (medium confidence: name verified in seller table, holdings in one section only) may sell up to ₹0.24 crore in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹0.18 crore gain is before offer expenses and taxes; proceeds are shown at offer price, with employee-portion shares sold at a discount.
Money already in hand since 11 Mar 2026 (8 months ago); unlock trigger was 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, so the window is not fresh.
Retained value of ₹0.57 crore is an estimate at offer price; the sale is worth a call as a stake-review conversation.
